args.title: Triage issue #4409: update README.md
args.body:
File: README.md

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: The running locally steps in README.md mention MinIO as the quickest option for an S3-compatible store, but omit setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 (and creating the bucket), causing uploads to fail against AWS defaults.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The running locally steps in README.md mention MinIO as the quickest option for an S3-compatible store, but omit setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 (and creating the bucket), causing uploads to fail against AWS defaults.
